intro R L
haveI : LieAlgebra.IsKilling R L := by assumption
let ad_range := (LieDerivation.ad R L).range
let ad_range_ideal : LieIdeal R L := (LieDerivation.ad R L).range
haveI : Nondegenerate (killingForm R L) := LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate R L
have nondegenerate_ad_range : Nondegenerate (killingForm R ad_range_ideal) :=
  by {
    let kill_form_ad_range := killingForm R ad_range_ideal
    haveI : IsLieAbelian ↥ad_range_ideal → ad_range_ideal = ⊥ :=
      LieAlgebra.IsKilling.ideal_eq_bot_of_isLieAbelian R L
    exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_nondegenerate R ad_range_ideal kill_form_ad_range this
  }
exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_nondegenerate R ad_range_ideal (killingForm R ad_range_ideal) nondegenerate_ad_range
